name: Climbing Gong
description: Tuned gongs whose energy climbs: a low stroke lights the registers above it one after another, stays on the chord, and darkens again from the top.

params.name: Metal
params.description: Where the tones of the metal stand. The first three are tuned to the key, Golden and Silver keep their own ratios, Plate is untuned. Heard from the next stroke.

params.name: Beater
params.description: What touches the metal. Felt, yarn and wood strike, the brush sweeps, and the bow goes on for as long as the key is held. Heard from the next stroke.

params.name: Hardness
params.description: How firm the beater is. Soft leans into the low tones and comes in gently; hard is quicker and brings the upper tones with the stroke.

params.name: Place
params.description: Where the metal is touched, from the middle to the rim. The middle gives the key and little else; towards the rim the tones above it come forward.

params.name: Ground
params.description: How loud the low tone of the key is beside the rest of the metal. At zero it is gone, and the tones above it come up in its place.

params.name: Climb
params.description: How much of a register's energy goes up to the next one. At zero the metal only rings; at the top everything is alight.

params.name: Threshold
params.description: How loud a register has to be before the next one wakes. Low lets soft strokes climb; high keeps the climb for hard ones.

params.name: Climb time
params.description: How long each register takes to light the one above it. Short is a splash, long is a slow rise.

params.name: Fall back
params.description: How much of what climbs comes down again. The low tone is spent on the climb and then given back while the top goes dark, so the light goes up in waves.

params.name: Roar
params.description: What the climb is made of, from clear tones to a wide rush of air that keeps to the tones of the metal.

params.name: Shimmer
params.description: Splits every tone into a pair this far apart, so that it beats. With none the metal is still.

params.name: Bend
params.description: How far a full stroke pulls the pitch away. It comes home as the metal dies down; up falls back to the key, down rises to it.

params.name: Low ring
params.description: How long the low tones ring. Higher keys ring a little shorter.

params.name: High ring
params.description: How long the highest tones hold on and how much light they gather. Short darkens soon after the climb; long keeps the top alight.

params.name: Roll
params.description: How hard the beater goes on striking while the key is held, in quick soft strokes that keep feeding the climb. The more of it, the softer the first stroke.

params.name: Roll speed
params.description: How many strokes of the roll fall in a second. Slow ones are single blows, heard one by one; quick ones are softer and run together into one tone.

params.name: Roll swell
params.description: How long the roll takes to grow to its full strength. Long ones rise slowly out of nothing when Roll is high.

params.name: Sympathy
params.description: How much the metals of the keys played before ring along. They hang on after a key is stopped.

params.name: Choke
params.description: How quickly the metal is stopped when its key is let go. At zero it rings out by itself; at the top a hand closes on it.

params.name: Width
params.description: How far the tones are spread between the speakers. With more of it the beating pairs turn from side to side.

params.name: Volume
params.description: Overall output level of the instrument.

origin.note: Written for live-mix on cpp/kit. The modes are the turning one-poles modal-bells uses. The registers feed each other through products of their own sums at audio rate, after published work on energy cascades in gongs, with the amounts set by a bounded law and voiced by measurement.
